integrity: All unconditional finite-rank and orbit claims derive from homogeneity and exact switching linear algebra; the observed finite verification checks are separately reproducible. No independent audit has occurred.

title: Marked-base orbit spectra and a sharp single-parameter recovery threshold for random bipartite reducts
